summary: Blaize Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a settlement agreement with Bess Ventures, an entity owned by board chair Lane M. Bess, to resolve prior disagreements. The company issued 2 million common shares to Bess Ventures as settlement consideration. The board, including disinterested members, approved the deal. The shares were issued in a private placement exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). There is no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event; this is a routine settlement and equity issuance.
